common.lb_table_hint: The input starts with the forecast (or the saved label). Editing a value ticks the row. Only ticked rows are saved.
common.lb_confirm_all_hint: Ticks every unlabeled row so the forecast is saved as the real value. Use only if the forecasts match the real readings.
common.lb_invalid_values: {n} ticked rows have a value outside 0 - {max} W/m2 and will be skipped.
common.lb_no_points: No forecasts, weather data or labels for this day
common.lb_no_runs: No forecast runs for this station on this day, so the inputs are empty. Type the measured values or upload a file.
common.lb_file_hint: Only rows on {date} are imported. Pick the time column and the GHI column (guessed for you). Times without timezone are treated as Thailand time. Duplicate slots keep the highest ID.

common.lb_login_required: Not signed in, or the session has expired
common.map_pick_hint: Click the map or drag the pin to set the station location.
common.admin_only: This page is for administrators (role: admin) only
common.ptarget_edit_hint: Edit this station's target and press Enter; the next forecast run uses it
common.ptarget_readonly_hint: This station's target is set by an administrator
common.no_forecast_desc: The model has not produced a forecast for this station yet. A new one is made every 10 minutes once the weather data is complete.
common.no_station: No station in the system yet
common.alerts_none: No station needs attention right now
common.ghi_note_blend: The blend trusts the satellite {pct}% at the first step, less later
common.ghi_note_lstm_only: No usable satellite image, so the blend equals the LSTM
common.cloud_forecast: Forecast cloud impact, every 10 minutes (taller bar = more light lost)
common.sat_ok: Real satellite frames; the newest is {minutes} min older than the weather data
common.sat_shifted: Some frames were missing, so an earlier set is used ({minutes} min older than the weather data)
common.sat_gap_skipped: One scan is missing, so 12 real frames are used with that scan left out; no frame is made up (the newest is {minutes} min older than the weather data)
common.sat_missing: No usable satellite image; the LSTM is used alone
common.sat_night: Night: a visible-light image cannot show the clouds
common.sat_low_sun: The sun is too low for the image to show the clouds; the LSTM is used alone
common.sat_model_unavailable: The image model could not be loaded; the LSTM is used alone
common.sat_image_alt: Himawari satellite image around the station
common.sat_image_none: No satellite image for this station yet
common.aoi_caption: White box = the 5×5 px area (about 78×55 km) used for the cloud cover
common.rule_matrix_title: Decision rules (the highlighted cell is the situation now)
common.rule_note_now: Result now: {level}. The cloud level is the highest in the next hour.
common.rule_note_night: At night there is no solar generation, so this table is not used and it is not an alert
common.rule_note_no_satellite: No cloud information from the satellite, treated as uncertain: a shortfall gets an extra buffer
common.help_desc: What the abbreviations, alert levels and cloud levels mean
common.help_ghi: Global horizontal irradiance in W/m²: the higher it is, the more the panels generate
common.help_pgen: Forecast power = panel area × efficiency × GHI ÷ 1000 (kW), from the GHI that blends the LSTM with the satellite
common.help_ptarget: The highest power the station has to deliver by plan (kW), set by the administrator. The target at a given time is the smaller of P_target and 80% of the clear-sky output at that time, so it is lower in the morning and evening.
common.help_dp: The largest amount by which P_gen falls below the target of that time within the next 3 hours (kW); 0 when the target is met throughout
common.help_reserve: Reserve to hold = ΔP plus a buffer for the model's forecast error
common.help_lstm: Model that forecasts GHI 3 hours ahead from the recent weather data
common.help_convlstm: Model that predicts the next 18 satellite frames. The first 30 minutes use what the newest real frame shows, after 90 minutes the model's forecast, and a mix in between. Without a complete 12-frame window only the newest real frame is used.
common.help_ghi_blend: Blend = LSTM weighted with the satellite result. The satellite weighs more at short lead times (about 80% at 10 min, 50% at 1 hour) and less later.
common.help_cloud: Cloud cover = cloudy pixels ÷ all pixels in the 5×5 px box around the station (about 78×55 km). The impact level comes from the expected loss of light.
common.help_alert_night: The sun is down, there is no generation; not an alert
common.help_alert_normal: The target is met for 3 hours and the cloud impact is low
common.help_alert_watch: The target is met but the cloud impact is medium: keep watching
common.help_alert_warning: Power will fall below the target, or the target is met but the cloud impact is high: prepare reserve
common.help_alert_critical: Power will fall below the target and the cloud impact is high: dispatch reserve now
common.help_cloud_method: The expected loss of light comes from the mean brightness of the satellite image in the box around the station, with a relation fitted on measured GHI (k = a − b × brightness): the brighter the box, the less light reaches the ground.
common.login_feat_lstm_desc: LSTM model, every 10 minutes, from recent weather data
common.login_feat_cloud_desc: ConvLSTM forecasts the cloud cover in the area around the station
common.login_feat_dss_desc: Compares generation with the target (ΔP) and recommends a reserve
common.signup_desc: A new account is an operator: forecasts, recommendations and alerts. Admin rights are given by an administrator.
common.signup_error_exists: This email already has an account. Use the Sign In tab.
common.signup_error_short: The password needs at least 8 characters
common.signup_error_mismatch: The two passwords do not match
common.signup_error_invalid: The email or password is not in a valid form
common.signup_error_network: Cannot reach the server. Please try again.
common.sat_observed_only: The 12-frame window is not complete yet, so the newest real frame is held for at most 1 hour (the frame is {minutes} min older than the weather data)
common.target_now_legend: Target for the time of day (never above P_target)
common.target_now_note: Target now {kw} kW, following the sun
common.fr_desc: A person checks the real frames before training. Rejected frames are left out of the ConvLSTM training set.
common.fr_batch: New frames collected for the next retrain
common.fr_batch_note: When full, the system retrains by itself (daytime scan times only)
common.fr_retrain_off: Retraining is off (ENABLE_RETRAIN=false); frames are still counted
common.fr_batch_unknown: No data yet; wait for the next ingestion round (every 10 minutes)
common.fr_run_rejected: Not better than before, not deployed
common.fr_how: The ConvLSTM learns to predict the next frame, so the answer is the real frame itself. What a person can add is which frames are not valid: black, partly missing or corrupted. The white box is the 5×5 px area around the station. Orange flags are hints from the system; they do not reject a frame by themselves.
common.fr_summary: {day} daytime frames · {flagged} flagged · {rejected} rejected · {night} night frames not shown (dark by nature)
common.fr_no_frames: No frames for this station and day
common.fr_saved: {saved} frames saved ({rejected} not usable, {accepted} usable); applies to the next retrain
common.help_band: The shaded band is the forecast plus and minus the model's error (RMSE) at that lead time, from the daytime part of the test set. About two thirds of the real values fall inside; a single-point sensor under broken cloud can fall outside.
common.sat_verified: Light relation checked against this station's sensor
common.sat_unverified: Light relation not yet checked against this station's sensor
common.sat_verified_tip: The relation between image brightness and light at the ground was fitted on GHI measured at this station
common.sat_unverified_tip: The relation was fitted at another station; no measured GHI of this station confirms it yet, so the satellite result may be further off
common.stale_desc: The newest result uses data up to {time} and was made {minutes} minutes ago, so it is not shown as the state now. The system fetches data and forecasts every 10 minutes.
common.dv_page_desc: The day's forecasts against what happened, and the forecast for the next 3 hours
common.dv_lead_label: Past hours show the value forecast ahead by
common.dv_mae_line: Mean error against measured GHI when forecasting about {lead} min ahead: blend {blend} W/m² · LSTM alone {lstm} W/m² ({n} time slots)
common.dv_mae_none: No measured GHI of this station for this day yet (an admin can add it on the Measured GHI page)
common.dv_cloud_title: Cloud around the station through the day (%)
common.dv_ghi_help: The blue line is the system's forecast. Past hours show the value forecast ahead by the selected lead time; after the vertical dashed line it is the newest forecast. Green dots are sensor values saved by an admin. The orange line is Open-Meteo, an estimate, not a measurement.
common.dv_power_help: Power = panel area × efficiency × GHI ÷ 1000, from the blended line. The target is the smaller of P_target and 80% of the clear-sky output. Green dots are computed from measured GHI with the same formula, not read from a power meter.
common.dv_cloud_help: The grey area is the cloud cover seen in the real satellite frame of each time. The blue line is the forecast cloud cover. The orange dashed line is the expected loss of light against clear sky, which sets the impact level (10% and 30%).
common.dv_no_data: No data of this day for this station
common.dv_no_cloud: No cloud data for this day (no daytime satellite frames)
common.cp_help: Himawari Band 03 frames, 64×64 px, the same ones the ConvLSTM reads. The white box is the 5×5 px area used for the cloud cover. Real frames come every 10 minutes; after them come the frames the ConvLSTM predicted in the newest round, which are model output, not photographs.
common.cp_no_frames: No daytime satellite frames for this day
common.cp_alt_predicted: Frame predicted by the ConvLSTM for {time}
common.cp_predicted_line: Predicted {lead} min ahead, from the real frame of {from}
common.cp_forecast_note: {n} predicted frames following the real frame of {from} (ConvLSTM v{version})
common.cp_no_forecast_round: The newest round has no predicted frames: {status}
common.cp_no_forecast_day: Predicted frames exist for today only
common.cp_slider: Move through the frames in time
common.cp_blank_note: {n} scans without an image from NICT left out
common.sat_short_shifted: an earlier window was used because newer frames are missing
common.sat_short_gap_skipped: ConvLSTM on 12 real frames, with the scan the satellite skipped left out
common.sat_short_observed_only: the 12-frame window is incomplete, only the newest real frame is used
common.sat_short_model_unavailable: the image model could not be loaded
common.in_desc: What the LSTM and the ConvLSTM are given to forecast today
common.in_lstm_title: LSTM input: 16 weather values per time slot, 6 hours back
common.in_lstm_how: Weather values come from Open-Meteo every 10–15 minutes. The system puts them on a 10-minute grid and feeds the newest 36 slots to the LSTM. The charts show today's values in Thailand time.
common.in_no_weather: No weather data of today for this station yet
common.in_latest_title: Newest values fed to the model (at {time})
common.in_src_computed_sun: Computed from the sun's position and the station's coordinates
common.in_dhi_missing: No value in this row (live rows stored before the evening of 5 Oct 2026 did not ask Open-Meteo for DHI). The system uses another row of the same 10-minute slot; if there is none the model receives 0
common.in_pressure_missing: No value in this row; the model receives 1008 hPa
common.in_time_features: Time codes: time of day, day of year and month, a sin and a cos each, computed from the slot time
common.in_not_used: Wind direction is not collected, and the model does not use Open-Meteo's cloud cover. Cloud information comes from the satellite frames below.
common.in_convlstm_title: ConvLSTM input: the 12 newest real satellite frames
common.in_convlstm_how: The ConvLSTM reads 12 consecutive Himawari Band 03 frames of 64×64 px (2 hours) and predicts 18 more. If a frame is missing the ConvLSTM is not used in that round, and no frame is made up.
common.in_window_incomplete: {n} of the 12 newest frames are missing
common.rt_desc: The versions in use, what is pending and the result of every run, for the LSTM and the ConvLSTM
common.rt_disabled: Retraining is off (ENABLE_RETRAIN=false). No new run will start.
common.rt_history_error: The history could not be read from MLflow
common.rt_lstm_trigger: Starts by itself after an admin saves measured GHI on
common.rt_lstm_trigger_short: Starts by itself 5 minutes after measured values are saved
common.rt_lstm_gate: Acceptance rule: the model learns from measured GHI while getting the same inputs as in a live forecast. The newest day with measured GHI is held out to decide and is not used for training. The new model is used when its error against the measured values of that day drops by at least 3%.
common.rt_convlstm_trigger: Starts by itself when enough new daytime frames have arrived. Frames rejected on
common.rt_convlstm_gate: Acceptance rule: the MSE of the predicted frames on the validation data (the newest period) must not be higher than that of the current model.
common.rt_reason_no_improvement_on_measured_ghi: The error against the measured values of the held-out day did not drop by the required amount
common.rt_reason_worse_on_weather_only_validati: Better against measured values, but more than 5% worse on the validation data without measurements
common.rt_reason_no_improvement_on_validation: No improvement on the validation data
common.rt_gate_weather: Passed the validation rule (no day to hold out yet)
common.rt_lstm_cols_help: Numbers read current model → new model; lower is better. The MAE against measured GHI is taken on the held-out day, which was not used for training in that run, and is the number that decides. The MAE against Open-Meteo values is shown for information and does not decide.
common.rt_lstm_old_check_note: * Runs with this mark were checked the earlier way, with measured values in the model input during the check. Their MAE against measured GHI is lower than in real use and cannot be compared with the runs without the mark.
common.rt_convlstm_cols_help: Numbers read current model → new model. Lower is better for MSE and the cloud % error; higher is better for SSIM.
common.stc_open_hint: Click to change this station's settings
common.stc_view_hint: Click to see this station's settings
common.stc_save_failed: Could not save. Check that you are signed in as an admin and try again.
common.stc_invalid: The name must not be empty, panel area and target must be above 0, efficiency must be between 0 and 100
common.stc_peak: Panels of this size give about {peak} kW in full sun (1,000 W/m²). The target is {pct}% of that.
common.stc_target_above_peak: The target is above what the panels can produce: the system will report a shortfall almost all the time.
common.stc_applies: New values apply from the next forecast round (within 10 minutes). Forecasts already saved are not recalculated.
common.stc_readonly: Only an admin can change these values
common.fr_accept_clean_tip: Marks every unreviewed frame without an automatic hint as usable. Flagged frames still need your decision. Press Save to confirm.
common.sat_checked_tip: The relation was fitted at another station and checked against {pairs} measured GHI values of this station: mean error {mae} in clear-sky index
common.in_src_dhi: Open-Meteo (rows stored before the evening of 5 Oct 2026: computed as GHI − DNI × cos(zenith))
common.theme_toggle: Switch between light and dark theme
common.lc_help: Every retrain run logs one value per epoch to MLflow: loss on the training data, error on the validation data and the learning rate. Epoch 0 is the model in use before the run. Use it to see whether the model converged, like the plots in TensorBoard.
common.lc_none: No run with per-epoch values yet (logging started on the evening of 5 Oct 2026). Curves appear from the next retrain run.
common.lc_read_lstm: How to read: the loss on the training data should keep falling. The MAE on the validation data tells whether the model got more accurate on data it was not trained on. If the loss still falls while the MAE rises, the model has started to memorise the training data, so the system keeps the weights of the epoch with the lowest MAE and stops after 3 epochs without improvement.
common.lc_read_convlstm: How to read: the loss on the training data should fall. Lower is better for the MSE on the validation data, higher is better for SSIM. The learning rate follows the cosine schedule. The system keeps the weights of the epoch with the lowest MSE.
common.lc_best_zero: No epoch of this run beat the current model (the best is epoch 0)
common.cal_title: Satellite light relation at this station
common.cal_help: The system turns satellite brightness into light at the ground with one relation for every station. After measured values are saved it measures by itself how far that relation is off at the station, using daytime measurements that have a satellite frame of the same time (a pair). At least {min} pairs are needed before a station counts as checked. The check does not change the relation.
common.cal_pending_note: Starts about 1 minute after a save and takes 1–2 minutes. This page updates by itself.
common.cal_detail_fitted: The relation was fitted on this station's measurements. Checked with {pairs} pairs: mean error {mae} in clear-sky index.
common.cal_detail_checked: The relation was fitted at another station and checked with {pairs} pairs of this station: mean error {mae} in clear-sky index.
common.cal_detail_insufficient: {pairs} pairs of the {min} needed: {missing} more. Add daytime measurements for days that have satellite frames.
common.cal_detail_not_checked: No measured values of this station in the system yet. Save or upload measurements and the check runs by itself.
common.cal_detail_waiting: Saved. Waiting for the next check.
common.cal_detail_no_file: There is no calibration file yet, so the satellite branch is not used.
